auckland.venue: Auckland's size makes location, travel time, parking, and booking availability practical parts of the decision.
auckland.service: Because Auckland is spread across a wide urban area, confirm suburb coverage, travel charges, response times, and whether the provider regularly works in your part of the city.

wellington.venue: In Wellington, the choice often comes down to CBD convenience, suburb location, transport, and whether the venue suits the weather and occasion.
wellington.service: Wellington's hills, weather exposure, access constraints, and older building stock can affect many property and mobile services, so local experience and clear scoping matter.

christchurch.venue: Christchurch options are spread between the central city and suburban centres, making location, parking, travel time, and opening hours worth checking.
christchurch.service: Greater Christchurch coverage can extend well beyond the central city, so confirm service boundaries, call-out costs, scheduling, and experience with the type of property or project involved.

hamilton.venue: Hamilton choices often serve both city residents and visitors from the wider Waikato, so location, parking, timing, and advance booking can affect the best fit.
hamilton.service: Some Hamilton providers also cover the wider Waikato while others stay within the city, so confirm travel boundaries, response times, and any regional call-out costs.

tauranga.venue: Tauranga, Mount Maunganui, and Papamoa create distinct location and travel considerations, especially at busy times and during summer.
tauranga.service: Coverage can vary across Tauranga, Mount Maunganui, Papamoa, and the wider Bay of Plenty, so check service areas, travel charges, and realistic scheduling before committing.

restaurants.summary: Restaurants can differ significantly in cuisine, service style, dietary support, atmosphere, price, and suitability for groups or special occasions.
restaurants.bestFor: comparing dining style, occasion, location, and booking needs

criteria.name: Dining style
criteria.advice: Match the menu and service format to the occasion, whether that is a quick meal, family dinner, group booking, or celebration.

criteria.name: Dietary fit
criteria.advice: Check current menus and contact the restaurant directly when allergies, vegetarian options, or other dietary requirements are important.

criteria.name: Booking details
criteria.advice: Compare opening days, reservation policies, group limits, deposits, and cancellation terms before making plans.

japanese-restaurants.summary: Japanese restaurants may specialise in sushi, sashimi, ramen, yakitori, teppanyaki, izakaya dining, or modern Japanese tasting menus.
japanese-restaurants.bestFor: matching a specific Japanese dining style to budget and occasion

criteria.name: Speciality
criteria.advice: Choose a venue whose main strength matches what you want rather than assuming every Japanese restaurant offers the same experience.

criteria.name: Freshness and preparation
criteria.advice: For raw seafood or chef-led menus, review current offerings and ask how dietary needs and ingredient availability are handled.

criteria.name: Service format
criteria.advice: Compare casual counter dining, table service, set menus, sharing plates, and booking requirements.

chinese-restaurants.summary: Chinese restaurants can focus on Cantonese, Sichuan, northern Chinese, regional specialities, yum cha, seafood, noodles, or banquet dining.
chinese-restaurants.bestFor: choosing the right regional style, group format, and spice level

criteria.name: Regional cuisine
criteria.advice: Look for the restaurant's stated regional focus because menus, flavours, cooking methods, and signature dishes vary widely.

criteria.name: Group suitability
criteria.advice: Check table sizes, banquet menus, yum cha timing, minimum spends, and reservation requirements for larger groups.

criteria.name: Dietary communication
criteria.advice: Ask directly about allergens, vegetarian preparation, and spice levels when these affect the meal.

indian-restaurants.summary: Indian restaurants may emphasise northern or southern regional cooking, vegetarian menus, tandoor dishes, street food, curries, or contemporary tasting experiences.
indian-restaurants.bestFor: comparing regional style, spice preference, dietary fit, and dining format

criteria.name: Regional focus
criteria.advice: Compare the restaurant's stated style and signature dishes instead of treating Indian cuisine as one uniform menu.

criteria.name: Dietary options
criteria.advice: Confirm vegan, vegetarian, gluten-aware, and allergy requirements directly because recipes and kitchen practices vary.

criteria.name: Heat and flavour
criteria.advice: Ask whether spice levels can be adjusted without changing the intended balance of the dish.

italian-restaurants.summary: Italian restaurants range from neighbourhood pizzerias and pasta bars to regional trattorias, wine-focused venues, and formal destination dining.
italian-restaurants.bestFor: matching menu style, atmosphere, and price to the occasion

criteria.name: Menu focus
criteria.advice: Decide whether pizza, handmade pasta, regional dishes, seafood, or a broader modern Italian menu is the priority.

criteria.name: Occasion and atmosphere
criteria.advice: Compare casual family dining, date-night ambience, group space, and special-occasion service.

criteria.name: Bookings and dietary needs
criteria.advice: Check reservations, set-menu requirements, and current gluten-free or vegetarian options before visiting.

thai-restaurants.summary: Thai restaurants may focus on regional dishes, street-food classics, shared dining, modern presentations, takeaway convenience, or a broad family-style menu.
thai-restaurants.bestFor: comparing flavour style, heat level, dietary support, and dining format

criteria.name: Menu style
criteria.advice: Look for regional specialities and signature dishes that distinguish the restaurant from a generic takeaway menu.

criteria.name: Spice preference
criteria.advice: Ask how heat levels are handled and whether milder versions preserve the intended flavour balance.

criteria.name: Dietary handling
criteria.advice: Confirm fish sauce, shellfish, nuts, gluten, vegan, and vegetarian requirements directly with the restaurant.

french-restaurants.summary: French dining can range from traditional bistros and brasseries to tasting menus, patisserie-led cafes, and New Zealand cuisine built on French technique.
french-restaurants.bestFor: choosing between casual bistro dining, a special occasion, and chef-led fine dining

criteria.name: Dining format
criteria.advice: Compare a la carte, set-menu, tasting-menu, all-day bistro, and brasserie formats before booking.

criteria.name: Occasion
criteria.advice: Match service style, atmosphere, waterfront or city location, and expected meal length to the event.

criteria.name: Current menu
criteria.advice: Seasonal menus can change frequently, so confirm dishes, dietary support, pricing, and booking terms on the official website.

cafes.summary: Cafes differ in coffee programme, breakfast and lunch menus, cabinet food, dietary options, seating, workspace suitability, and weekend demand.
cafes.bestFor: comparing coffee, food, atmosphere, access, and timing

criteria.name: Food and coffee
criteria.advice: Check whether the cafe's strengths match your priority, such as specialty coffee, brunch, quick takeaway, or cabinet food.

criteria.name: Space and access
criteria.advice: Compare seating, parking, accessibility, outdoor tables, and whether the venue suits children, meetings, or laptop work.

criteria.name: Peak-time practicality
criteria.advice: Weekend queues, kitchen closing times, and table policies can change the experience, so check before travelling.

hotels.summary: Hotels vary by location, room type, parking, facilities, check-in flexibility, cancellation terms, and suitability for business, families, or events.
hotels.bestFor: matching location and facilities to the purpose of the stay

criteria.name: Location
criteria.advice: Compare the actual address with the places you need to reach, including transport, parking, and late-night access.

criteria.name: Room and facilities
criteria.advice: Check room configuration, accessibility, breakfast, workspace, laundry, gym, pool, and family requirements.

criteria.name: Booking conditions
criteria.advice: Review the final rate, payment timing, cancellation policy, deposits, and check-in or check-out limits.

bars.summary: Bars can specialise in cocktails, wine, craft beer, live music, sports viewing, food, rooftop settings, or late-night social occasions.
bars.bestFor: matching drinks, atmosphere, group needs, and opening hours

criteria.name: Atmosphere
criteria.advice: Choose between quiet conversation, live entertainment, sports, dancing, or a food-led experience.

criteria.name: Drinks and food
criteria.advice: Check the current drinks list, kitchen hours, non-alcoholic options, and any minimum spend for groups.

criteria.name: Entry and bookings
criteria.advice: Confirm age restrictions, dress expectations, event tickets, reservations, and late-night transport.

nightclubs.summary: Nightclubs differ by music programme, crowd, entry policy, event schedule, closing time, security, and proximity to safe late-night transport.
nightclubs.bestFor: comparing music, events, entry conditions, and late-night practicality

criteria.name: Music and events
criteria.advice: Check the specific event and performer rather than relying on the venue's general genre description.

criteria.name: Entry conditions
criteria.advice: Confirm ticketing, door charges, age limits, identification, dress expectations, and re-entry rules.

criteria.name: Late-night planning
criteria.advice: Consider closing time, coat storage, group safety, transport, and where rideshare pickup is practical.

builders.summary: Builders may specialise in new homes, renovations, extensions, structural work, repairs, project management, or a particular construction system.
builders.bestFor: matching proven project experience to scope, budget, and delivery risk

criteria.name: Relevant experience
criteria.advice: Ask for recent examples that match the size, building type, complexity, and consent requirements of your project.

criteria.name: Scope and pricing
criteria.advice: Compare detailed inclusions, exclusions, allowances, variations, payment stages, and who coordinates subcontractors.

criteria.name: Licensing and process
criteria.advice: Verify the people doing restricted building work, insurance, contracts, communication, programme, and defect handling.

electricians.summary: Electricians can cover urgent faults, rewiring, switchboards, lighting, heat pumps, EV charging, data work, and commercial maintenance.
electricians.bestFor: matching registration, response time, and technical capability to the job

criteria.name: Registration and certification
criteria.advice: Verify who will perform the work and what electrical certificate or record of work should be supplied.

criteria.name: Job capability
criteria.advice: Confirm experience with the exact system, building type, fault, upgrade, or installation required.

criteria.name: Call-out and scope
criteria.advice: Compare response time, minimum charges, materials, access assumptions, exclusions, and after-hours rates.

plumbers.summary: Plumbers may handle leaks, hot water, blocked drains, bathrooms, gas work, maintenance, renovations, and urgent after-hours call-outs.
plumbers.bestFor: matching licensing, response time, equipment, and scope to the plumbing problem

criteria.name: Trade capability
criteria.advice: Check whether the job needs a plumber, gasfitter, drainlayer, specialist equipment, or coordination with other trades.

criteria.name: Urgency and access
criteria.advice: Confirm response time, after-hours pricing, site access, isolation steps, and what information to provide before arrival.

criteria.name: Quote detail
criteria.advice: Compare labour, call-out charges, parts, investigation time, reinstatement, warranties, and likely variations.

renovation-services.summary: Renovation companies can manage design, consenting, kitchens, bathrooms, extensions, interior work, trade coordination, and complete home upgrades.
renovation-services.bestFor: comparing project leadership, design capability, scope control, and relevant renovation experience

criteria.name: Delivery model
criteria.advice: Clarify whether the company provides design-and-build, construction only, project management, or selected trade packages.

criteria.name: Comparable projects
criteria.advice: Review recent work with a similar property type, budget, consent complexity, and level of finish.

criteria.name: Budget and variations
criteria.advice: Compare allowances, exclusions, decision deadlines, change control, payment stages, and how hidden conditions are handled.

painters.summary: Painters may specialise in interiors, exteriors, roofs, commercial work, heritage surfaces, preparation, repairs, spraying, or decorative finishes.
painters.bestFor: comparing preparation standards, coating systems, access, and finish expectations

criteria.name: Surface preparation
criteria.advice: Ask exactly how washing, sanding, filling, repairs, priming, masking, and lead-paint risks will be managed.

criteria.name: Paint system
criteria.advice: Compare specified products, number of coats, colour process, finish level, and suitability for the surface and exposure.

criteria.name: Site management
criteria.advice: Confirm access equipment, protection, cleanup, weather planning, programme, warranty, and what is excluded.

mechanics.summary: Mechanics may provide scheduled servicing, WOF repairs, diagnostics, brakes, suspension, electrical work, tyres, transmission work, or marque-specific expertise.
mechanics.bestFor: matching workshop capability, diagnosis, communication, and parts policy to the vehicle

criteria.name: Vehicle expertise
criteria.advice: Confirm experience with the make, model, age, fuel type, and specific fault or maintenance requirement.

criteria.name: Diagnostic process
criteria.advice: Ask how faults are tested, when approval is requested, and how diagnostic time is charged.

criteria.name: Estimate and parts
criteria.advice: Compare labour, genuine or aftermarket parts, warranties, priority repairs, courtesy transport, and completion timing.

car-dealers.summary: Car dealers differ in vehicle mix, inspection standards, finance, trade-ins, warranties, after-sales support, and experience with imported or electric vehicles.
car-dealers.bestFor: comparing vehicle condition, total cost, dealer obligations, and after-sales support

criteria.name: Vehicle evidence
criteria.advice: Review history, ownership, odometer documentation, inspection results, service records, safety features, and any known damage.

criteria.name: Total purchase cost
criteria.advice: Compare on-road costs, finance, interest, fees, trade-in value, insurance add-ons, and warranty terms.

criteria.name: Independent checks
criteria.advice: Use a pre-purchase inspection and verify registration, money owing, Consumer Information Notice details, and charging needs for EVs.

panel-beaters.summary: Panel beaters may handle insurance repairs, accident damage, paint matching, chassis alignment, rust, dent removal, and vehicle restoration.
panel-beaters.bestFor: matching repair capability, insurer process, equipment, and finish quality to the damage

criteria.name: Repair capability
criteria.advice: Confirm experience with the vehicle construction, material, paint system, sensors, cameras, and structural work involved.

criteria.name: Insurance process
criteria.advice: Ask who handles assessment, insurer approval, supplements, excess, loan vehicles, and updates.

criteria.name: Finish and warranty
criteria.advice: Compare repair method, paint matching, calibration, quality checks, completion estimates, and workmanship warranty.

car-wash.summary: Car-wash options range from automatic and self-service bays to hand washing, mobile valeting, interior cleaning, paint correction, and full detailing.
car-wash.bestFor: matching cleaning depth, paint safety, location, and time to the vehicle's condition

criteria.name: Service depth
criteria.advice: Choose between a maintenance wash, interior clean, valet, decontamination, polish, correction, or protective coating.

criteria.name: Vehicle and paint care
criteria.advice: Ask about wash methods, products, drying, wheel treatment, delicate finishes, and how existing damage is recorded.

criteria.name: Time and access
criteria.advice: Compare booking, queue time, mobile requirements, water or power access, weather policy, and collection arrangements.

tyre-shops.summary: Tyre shops can supply tyres, puncture repairs, balancing, wheel alignment, rotations, fleet service, and advice for EVs, 4WDs, and commercial vehicles.
tyre-shops.bestFor: matching tyre specification, safety, value, and fitting capability to the vehicle

criteria.name: Correct specification
criteria.advice: Compare size, load and speed rating, vehicle use, manufacturer guidance, EV needs, and replacement-pair strategy.

criteria.name: Fitted price
criteria.advice: Check whether quotes include fitting, balancing, valves, disposal, alignment checks, GST, and warranty support.

criteria.name: Diagnosis and safety
criteria.advice: Ask about uneven wear, suspension issues, puncture repair limits, wheel damage, rotations, and alignment.

cleaning-services.summary: Cleaning companies may focus on regular homes, offices, end-of-tenancy work, deep cleans, windows, carpets, construction cleanup, or specialised hygiene services.
cleaning-services.bestFor: matching scope, frequency, staffing, products, and quality control to the property

criteria.name: Written scope
criteria.advice: Compare exactly which rooms, surfaces, tasks, products, equipment, and exclusions are included.

criteria.name: People and security
criteria.advice: Ask about employee screening, supervision, keys, alarms, insurance, access, and whether the same cleaners return.

criteria.name: Quality and pricing
criteria.advice: Confirm frequency, minimum hours, supplies, GST, issue resolution, cancellation terms, and how quality is checked.

hypnotherapists.summary: Hypnotherapists may work with habits, anxiety, confidence, sleep, performance, pain support, or broader coaching approaches using different training backgrounds.
hypnotherapists.bestFor: matching practitioner training, scope, approach, and expectations to the goal

criteria.name: Training and scope
criteria.advice: Review relevant qualifications, professional memberships, continuing education, and whether the issue sits within the practitioner's scope.

criteria.name: Approach and expectations
criteria.advice: Ask how sessions work, what evidence or limitations are discussed, and how progress is reviewed without guaranteed outcomes.

criteria.name: Safety and referral
criteria.advice: Clarify confidentiality, informed consent, health considerations, and when the practitioner refers to a registered health professional.

accountants.summary: Accountants can support tax compliance, annual accounts, GST, payroll, management reporting, cash flow, structures, succession, and business advice.
accountants.bestFor: matching industry experience, service depth, communication, and systems to the business

criteria.name: Relevant experience
criteria.advice: Ask about clients with a similar size, industry, structure, growth stage, and reporting needs.

criteria.name: Service model
criteria.advice: Compare compliance-only support with forecasting, management reporting, systems advice, meetings, and proactive planning.

criteria.name: Fees and responsiveness
criteria.advice: Clarify fixed or hourly fees, software costs, turnaround, contact people, response standards, and work outside scope.

financial-advisers.summary: Financial advisers may focus on investments, retirement, insurance, cash flow, debt, estate considerations, or comprehensive financial planning.
financial-advisers.bestFor: matching licensed advice scope, investment philosophy, fees, and ongoing service to the goal

criteria.name: Licensed scope
criteria.advice: Check the Financial Service Providers Register, the provider's disclosure, and whether the adviser can cover the advice you need.

criteria.name: Advice process
criteria.advice: Ask how goals, risk, alternatives, conflicts, product selection, records, and recommendations are documented.

criteria.name: Fees and ongoing service
criteria.advice: Compare fees, commissions, implementation costs, review frequency, reporting, and what happens when circumstances change.

kiwisaver-advisers.summary: KiwiSaver advisers can help with fund choice, risk settings, contributions, first-home withdrawals, retirement planning, and understanding provider differences.
kiwisaver-advisers.bestFor: matching regulated advice, risk tolerance, fees, and contribution strategy to the member

criteria.name: Advice scope
criteria.advice: Confirm whether the adviser compares multiple providers and how their licence, disclosure, and product relationships affect recommendations.

criteria.name: Risk and timeframe
criteria.advice: Check how goals, withdrawal timing, market risk, contribution rate, and capacity for loss are assessed.

criteria.name: Fees and follow-up
criteria.advice: Compare adviser fees, provider fees, commissions, review service, switching process, and ongoing communication.

lawyers.summary: Law firms may specialise in property, commercial work, disputes, family matters, employment, trusts, estates, immigration, or criminal law.
lawyers.bestFor: matching legal expertise, conflict checks, communication, and fee structure to the matter

criteria.name: Relevant expertise
criteria.advice: Ask who will handle the matter and what recent experience they have with similar facts, complexity, and urgency.

criteria.name: Strategy and communication
criteria.advice: Compare the proposed next steps, risks, realistic outcomes, response standards, and who makes day-to-day decisions.

criteria.name: Fees and scope
criteria.advice: Request a clear engagement letter covering estimates, retainers, disbursements, GST, exclusions, and how changes are approved.

real-estate-agents.summary: Real-estate agents differ in local sales record, appraisal evidence, campaign strategy, buyer database, communication, fees, and auction or negotiation skill.
real-estate-agents.bestFor: matching recent local evidence and campaign execution to the property

criteria.name: Comparable sales
criteria.advice: Ask for recent nearby results involving a similar property type, price bracket, condition, and buyer audience.

criteria.name: Campaign plan
criteria.advice: Compare pricing method, preparation, photography, advertising, open homes, buyer follow-up, reporting, and negotiation.

criteria.name: Fees and agreement
criteria.advice: Review commission, marketing costs, agency term, cancellation, expenses, disclosures, and what happens if the property does not sell.

insurance-brokers.summary: Insurance brokers may advise on business, liability, property, vehicle, marine, professional, cyber, life, or personal risk cover.
insurance-brokers.bestFor: matching advice scope, insurer access, disclosure, and claims support to the risks involved

criteria.name: Risk assessment
criteria.advice: Check how the broker identifies material risks, sums insured, exclusions, excesses, and gaps rather than comparing premium alone.

criteria.name: Market access and conflicts
criteria.advice: Ask which insurers are considered, how recommendations are made, and how commissions, fees, or relationships are disclosed.

criteria.name: Claims and review
criteria.advice: Compare claims advocacy, annual review, documentation, response times, and support when circumstances change.

mortgage-brokers.summary: Mortgage brokers can help with first-home lending, refinancing, investment property, construction finance, self-employed applications, and loan restructuring.
mortgage-brokers.bestFor: matching lender access, borrower experience, structure advice, and process support to the application

criteria.name: Borrower experience
criteria.advice: Choose a broker who regularly handles your situation, such as first-home, self-employed, investor, refinance, or construction lending.

criteria.name: Lender comparison
criteria.advice: Ask which lenders are considered, what is excluded, and how rate, fees, servicing policy, incentives, and approval risk are weighed.

criteria.name: Loan structure and support
criteria.advice: Compare advice on repayments, fixed terms, split loans, flexibility, documentation, deadlines, and help through settlement.

business-loans.summary: Business-finance providers may offer overdrafts, term loans, asset finance, invoice funding, working capital, property-backed lending, or marketplace comparisons.
business-loans.bestFor: matching purpose, cash flow, security, total cost, and repayment structure to the business

criteria.name: Funding fit
criteria.advice: Match the facility term and repayment pattern to the asset, working-capital need, project, or revenue cycle being funded.

criteria.name: Total cost
criteria.advice: Compare interest, establishment and broker fees, early repayment, default costs, personal guarantees, security, and GST treatment.

criteria.name: Process and risk
criteria.advice: Ask about required financials, approval timing, covenants, reporting, renewal risk, and the impact of missed repayments.

creative-agencies.summary: Creative agencies may combine brand strategy, naming, design, websites, content, campaigns, video, digital products, and ongoing marketing support.
creative-agencies.bestFor: matching specialist capability, strategic thinking, delivery team, and commercial outcomes to the brief

criteria.name: Relevant work
criteria.advice: Review case studies with comparable audience, complexity, channel mix, budget, and measurable business problem.

criteria.name: Team and process
criteria.advice: Clarify who leads strategy, design, development, content, production, project management, and day-to-day communication.

criteria.name: Scope and ownership
criteria.advice: Compare deliverables, rounds, timelines, dependencies, third-party costs, source files, intellectual property, and support after launch.

broadband-providers.summary: Broadband providers differ by fibre or wireless availability, speed, congestion, data policy, router, support, contract, installation, and business features.
broadband-providers.bestFor: matching real address availability, performance, support, and contract terms to the household or business

criteria.name: Address availability
criteria.advice: Check the exact address and technology because advertised plans may not be available or perform the same everywhere.

criteria.name: Performance needs
criteria.advice: Compare download and upload use, household size, video calls, gaming, cloud backups, Wi-Fi coverage, and peak-time expectations.

criteria.name: Terms and support
criteria.advice: Review installation, router ownership, contract length, notice, price changes, support hours, static IP, and outage handling.

computer-repairs.summary: Computer-repair providers may handle diagnostics, hardware, operating systems, data recovery, malware, upgrades, custom PCs, networks, and on-site business support.
computer-repairs.bestFor: matching technical capability, data handling, turnaround, and repair economics to the device

criteria.name: Diagnostic scope
criteria.advice: Explain the symptoms and ask how diagnosis is charged, what tests are run, and when repair approval is requested.

criteria.name: Data and privacy
criteria.advice: Confirm backup responsibility, access to personal data, security, password handling, data-recovery risk, and disposal.

criteria.name: Repair value
criteria.advice: Compare parts, labour, warranty, turnaround, loan options, data transfer, and whether replacement is more economical.

travel-agencies.summary: Travel agencies may specialise in complex airfares, cruises, tours, corporate travel, groups, luxury trips, family holidays, or destination expertise.
travel-agencies.bestFor: matching itinerary complexity, destination knowledge, support, and booking terms to the trip

criteria.name: Relevant expertise
criteria.advice: Choose an adviser with current experience in the destination, trip style, fare type, accessibility, or group needs involved.

criteria.name: Support model
criteria.advice: Ask who helps with changes, disruptions, emergencies, supplier problems, time zones, and travel while you are away.

criteria.name: Fees and conditions
criteria.advice: Compare planning or booking fees, markups, deposits, cancellation, supplier terms, insurance, and refund handling.

movers.summary: Moving companies may provide local or intercity transport, packing, storage, office relocations, apartment access, fragile-item handling, and furniture delivery.
movers.bestFor: matching capacity, access planning, protection, timing, and liability terms to the move

criteria.name: Detailed inventory
criteria.advice: Give an accurate item list, stairs, lifts, parking, access, heavy items, dismantling, packing, and storage requirements.

criteria.name: Quote structure
criteria.advice: Compare hourly or fixed pricing, travel, minimums, extra staff, materials, delays, waiting time, GST, and likely variations.

criteria.name: Protection and timing
criteria.advice: Ask about insurance or liability, blankets and wrapping, fragile items, arrival windows, cancellations, and damage claims.

air-conditioning.summary: Air-conditioning and heat-pump providers may design, install, service, clean, diagnose, and repair residential or commercial systems.
air-conditioning.bestFor: matching system design, installer capability, efficiency, placement, and after-sales support to the building

criteria.name: System design
criteria.advice: Ask how room size, insulation, sun, layout, airflow, noise, moisture, use pattern, and future needs affect sizing.

criteria.name: Installation scope
criteria.advice: Compare equipment, electrical work, drainage, pipe routes, penetrations, access, permits, commissioning, and cleanup.

criteria.name: Running cost and support
criteria.advice: Review efficiency, controls, filters, maintenance, parts, warranties, servicing, and who handles future faults.

fitness-equipment.summary: Fitness-equipment suppliers may provide cardio machines, racks, weights, functional training gear, flooring, home gyms, commercial fit-outs, delivery, and servicing.
fitness-equipment.bestFor: matching equipment quality, space, user needs, delivery, warranty, and maintenance to the setup

criteria.name: Use and specification
criteria.advice: Match load rating, dimensions, adjustability, biomechanics, noise, power, floor strength, and user range to the intended use.

criteria.name: Space and delivery
criteria.advice: Measure access, stairs, doors, ceiling height, safety clearances, flooring, assembly, placement, and future relocation.

criteria.name: Support and value
criteria.advice: Compare warranty, parts, servicing, software subscriptions, installation, training, resale, and total ownership cost.

gyms.summary: Gyms differ in equipment, classes, coaching, crowd levels, opening hours, parking, accessibility, culture, contract terms, and specialist training facilities.
gyms.bestFor: matching facilities, support, location, schedule, and membership terms to a sustainable routine

criteria.name: Training fit
criteria.advice: Check the equipment, classes, coaching, recovery areas, accessibility, and specialist facilities needed for your programme.

criteria.name: Practical routine
criteria.advice: Visit at the time you would train to assess travel, parking, crowding, cleanliness, safety, and staff availability.

criteria.name: Membership terms
criteria.advice: Compare joining fees, minimum term, notice, freezes, cancellation, class costs, guest access, and personal-training charges.
